title: API key and webhook secret on adjacent lines
summary: A live API key and a webhook signing secret appear on consecutive lines of one configuration file.
rationale: One input involves two families at once: both values are credentials, and neither must swallow the other's span.

expectation.rationale: Both values match their contracts; the webhook contract is corroborated by SDK source only, which caps the whole case at tool-corroborated.

sources.supports: Constructs and verifies the exc_whsec_ shape.
